messages.title: JOIN THE NETWORK
messages.body: Come talk builds, report bugs and grab codes early on our Discord. Tap the Discord button on the main menu.

messages.title: LAUNCH DAY — HOLD THE LINE
messages.body:
NODE ZERO is live. One core. Endless swarm. You're on the line now.

Here's 10,000 Scrap to kick the Workshop into gear — spend it, die gloriously, climb again.

Inbox is where patch notes, events and extra gifts land. Watch this space.

Builds, bugs and early codes: Discord button on the main menu.

messages.title: GET ON THE LEADERBOARDS
messages.body:
Pilot, your scores might be hidden! Google Play Games makes new profiles PRIVATE by default, so nobody else can see you on the boards.

To fix it: open the Play Games app → tap your profile icon → Settings → Play Games profile → Privacy & Settings → choose Public profile.

Then beat your own best once. Scores set while private stay hidden, so you need one new record to show up for everyone.

And if you haven't yet, come say hi on Discord: tap the Discord button on the main menu. Builds, bugs, early codes and sneak peeks. We'd love to have you there!

messages.title: YOUR REVIEW HELPS IMMENSELY ❤️
messages.body:
Pilot, a small favor from the person behind NODE ZERO ❤️

I'm the sole developer and publisher, and with no marketing budget, I rely on your word of mouth to help the game grow.

If you have a moment, please leave an honest review on Google Play. It helps immensely with getting NODE ZERO discovered, and your feedback helps me make it better.

Leave a review: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.nodezero.towerdefense

Thank you for playing and giving this game a chance. Your support means the world to me.

Vlad
